en: The Philippines has 7,641 islands according to NAMRIA, not the commonly taught figure of 7,107 islands.
Mount Apo in Davao is the highest mountain in the Philippines at 2,954 meters, not Mount Mayon.
Davao City is the largest city in the Philippines by land area at 2,444 square kilometers, not Manila.
The Cagayan River in Luzon is the longest river in the Philippines at approximately 505 kilometers, not the Pasig River.
The Philippine eagle's main habitat is the forests of Mindanao, not exclusively the forests of Luzon.
The famous Chocolate Hills are located in the province of Bohol, not in Cebu.
Taal Volcano sits on Volcano Island, which is located within Taal Lake in Batangas, not on the mainland.
Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park is located in the Sulu Sea, not in the South China Sea.
Mayon Volcano in Albay is famous for its nearly perfect cone shape, not for having a flat top.
Palawan belongs to the MIMAROPA region in the Luzon island group, not to the Visayas.
The Cordillera Administrative Region is an administrative region containing six provinces, not a single province.
The Banaue Rice Terraces in Ifugao were hand-carved by indigenous people over 2,000 years ago, not formed naturally.
